name: Inhuman [ENDLESS MODE!]
desc:
👍 LIKE the game for CHAPTER 2
⭐ JOIN THE GROUP FOR A FREE TOOL

👁 Your goal is to determine whether humans are real or not.
🔎 Investigate humans to uncover visual or audio clues and expose the fakes. 👤❌
⚠️ Beware: Fakes can almost mimic real humans precisely, so stay sharp!
💥 Eliminate all the fakes before they take over the world!

🔴 Want a larger CHALLENGE? PLAY NIGHTMARE MODE

[PC CONTROLS]
Shift - Sprint
Backspace - Drop any droppable items

[CONSOLE]
L3/Left Joystick - Sprint
R1 and L1 - Inventory Switch

[TAGS] horror, zombies, scary, night shift, multiplayer, 2 player, weird, strict, puzzle

[INSPIRATION] Inspired by 'The Quarantine Zone'
